block.nerotech.solar_array.tooltip: Basic single-block panel: clean daytime power, takes upgrade modules
block.nerotech.solar_array.tooltip.neros: For tiered, poolable high-output solar, see Nerospace's Solar Panels
block.nerotech.collider_core.tooltip: Lay Accelerator Guide Coils in a loop at this block's own height and right-click each to set its bend; the controller injects a particle, accelerates it round the loop and collides it with a second one. Bigger rings reach higher speeds, and higher speeds unlock the richer recipes
block.nerotech.accelerator_coil.tooltip: Steers the beam 45 degrees; right-click with an empty hand or the Configurator to cycle straight / left / right. Place them at the controller's height, up to 16 blocks apart
block.nerotech.chemical_processor.toolti: Washes raw ore into 3 dust; each operation also consumes oxygen (chemicalProcessorGasPerOp, default 250 mB)
block.nerotech.radiator.tooltip: Enhanced coolant: sheds as much machine heat as four blocks of ice, and feeds an adjacent Coolant Pump
block.nerotech.coolant_pump.tooltip: Burns NE to pull heat out of every adjacent machine; each Radiator within 3 blocks in a straight line doubles, triples, ... the pull. To move heat somewhere useful instead, use a Heat Exchanger
block.nerotech.conveyor_belt.tooltip: Pushes item entities along its facing; no power, no block entity. Chain them into lines and corners
block.nerotech.robotic_arm.tooltip: Moves items once a second from the container behind it into the one in front; set the filter slot to move only one item
block.nerotech.singularity_vault.tooltip: Bulk storage for ONE item type (singularityVaultCapacity). Breaking it keeps the contents: a small store spills as items, a large one stays inside the dropped vault
block.nerotech.singularity_vault.mismatc: This vault is already holding a different item
gui.nerotech.collider.status.fizzled_gap: Particle lost - guides too far apart
message.nerotech.tech_guide.empty: The pedestal is empty — install a Tech Guide Datapad.
gui.nerotech.auto_crafter.locked_hint: Grid locked — only template items can be inserted
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.machine_fra: Every machine starts with parts: Machine Frames, Circuit Boards and Nero Coils. Craft your first component and the workshop is open.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.nero_genera: The Nero Generator burns coal and fuel into NE — your first power source. It runs hot and it smokes: every burn adds to the region's pollution. Remember that.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.solar_array: The Solar Array trickles clean power while the sun is up — weaker than combustion, but it adds nothing to the smog and never asks for fuel.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.clear_skies: A bank of four Solar Arrays can carry a small base through the day. Clean capacity now means less scrubbing later.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.ore_process: The Ore Processor grinds raw ore into double dust. Feed it power, keep it cool, and your mining trips pay out twice.
The Fabricator presses refined materials into Machine Frames, Circuit Boards and Nero Coils — the component line every later machine is built on.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.advanced_or: The Advanced Ore Processor's plasma arc squeezes bonus dust out of every operation, and chews through whole raw-ore blocks in one pass. It is built from Starsteel, so it arrives with the orbital metals.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.advanced_fa: The Advanced Fabricator assembles space-tier components — including the Fusion Cells the reactor burns. The top of the processing chain.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.particle_co: The Particle Accelerator is the standalone road to space-grade dust. Lay Accelerator Guide Coils in a loop at the Accelerator Controller's own height, right-click each one to bend the beam 45°, and close the loop back into the controller. Inject a particle, put its collision partner in the second slot, and wait for the beam to reach the energy the recipe demands.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.heat_manage: Working machines build heat; an overheated machine throttles. Machines shed heat faster beside water, ice and snow — stock coolant before the red gauge does it for you.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.dirty_filte: Pollution is regional and it lingers. A fouled filter, black with everything your machines put into the air, is the receipt. Reprocess it in the Ore Processor for a partial iron refund.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.scrubber.te: The Scrubber eats pollution out of its region while it has power and a Filter Cartridge. Park one beside your generators and change the filter when it fouls.
The Remediator goes further than the Scrubber: it restores ground scarred by heavy pollution, sweeping its booms over the land until the region reads clean.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.auto_crafte: Lock a recipe into the Auto Crafter's grid and it stamps out the product for as long as it has power and ingredients. Retire the crafting bench.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.item_sorter: The Item Sorter routes streams by filter, side by side. Give each face a filter and the factory sorts itself.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.configurato: The Configurator sets each machine face to in / out / off, and copies one machine's side config onto the next. The last piece of a hands-free line.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.analytics_t: The Analytics Terminal watches every machine in range: status, efficiency, heat and the region's pollution on one dashboard. Every machine also carries its own analytics tab.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.fusion_cont: A fusion torus needs a formed hollow shell — Fusion Casing walls with a Containment Glass viewport, 3x3x3 up to 5x5x5. Bigger shells burn hotter fuels.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.fusion_reac: The Fusion Reactor controller validates the shell and lights the torus. Watch the heat: a starved or broken shell risks meltdown, and meltdowns are not gentle.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.stellar_fue: Fuel tiers climb from Fusion Cells through Plasma Cells to Stellar Cells — each hotter, denser and pickier about its shell. A Stellar Cell in hand means the top of the tech tree.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.collider_ri: Everything exotic starts at the Particle Accelerator, and the only way up is OUT. A loop's top speed is 20x the shortest stretch that ends in a bend, so stretch your guides to eleven blocks or more before you go looking for antimatter — a tight octagon will never get there.
Collide two Stellar Cells at 12,000 J and what comes out is an Antimatter Cell — tier-4 fusion fuel, twice the burn of a Stellar Cell, and only the full 7x7x7 shell will hold it. It also drives the reactor's heat up by half again: this is the fuel that courts a meltdown on purpose.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.singularity: The Singularity Vault folds a million of ONE item into a single block. Feed the input face, pull from the output face, and read the fill with a comparator. Breaking it keeps what it holds.
nerotech.machine_charge.refused: The owner could not pay this machine's operating charge
command.nerotech.gallery.built: Built the NeroTech gallery: %s blocks on the display grid, 4 live processing lines (ore → dust, iron → frames, Void Crystal → Fusion Cells), a coal-burning Nero Generator charging a Battery with a Scrubber eating its emissions, a Solar Array, a Remediator, an Auto Crafter mid-craft, an Item Sorter routing its front stream, an Analytics Terminal watching the strip, a loaded Tech Guide pedestal at the centre, and formed 3×3×3 + 5×5×5 Fusion Reactor shells burning their tier fuels.
command.nerotech.gallery.cleared: Cleared the NeroTech gallery: %s blocks → air, %s entities removed.

chapter.nerotech.industrial_record.title: Industrial Record
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.first_c: You assembled a machine frame, a circuit board and a Nero coil by hand: the parts every NeroTech machine is built from.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.first_s: A Nero Generator is humming and the world has entered the age of industrial power. Every later machine on this page runs on that first spark.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.ore_dou: An Ore Processor turned raw ore into a stack of iron dust, so each vein now yields more than a furnace alone ever gave you.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.fabrica: With a Fabricator on the line you put together a batch of circuit boards. Components are now something you produce, not something you craft one at a time.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.clear_s: Solar arrays and a wind turbine: power drawn from sunlight and wind, with nothing burned and nothing in the air.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.the_gri: Battery storage, a grid controller, wireless nodes and your first machine upgrades: your machines now share one connected network.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.heat_an: Radiators and coolant pumps to manage heat, an electrolyzer to split water, a gas turbine to burn what it makes. The thermal side of the works is in place.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.clean_c: A scrubber, a remediator and spare filter cartridges. Your industry now has a way to clean up after itself.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.ignitio: A fusion reactor core, casing, containment glass and a fusion cell to feed it. Everything a star in a box needs is in your hands.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.stellar: Plasma cells and stellar cells, the denser fuels that keep a fusion reactor running hot and long.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.particl: Accelerator coils, a collider core and your first pinch of starsteel dust, made by smashing matter into something new.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.antimat: An antimatter cell out of the collider and a singularity vault to store a million of anything. This is where NeroTech's industrial road ends.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.world_r: Somewhere on this server a fusion reactor ran too hot and was throttled, and somebody brought it back down to safe temperatures. That near miss is recorded here.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.world_s: A region of this world that had grown thick with pollution drifted back below the warning line on its own, with nothing but time doing the work. The air there is clean again.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.world_r: Somewhere on this server a scrubber or a remediator pulled a polluted region back below the warning line. Not waited out: cleaned up.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.fusion_: Your fusion reactor's shell closed and the controller came alive for the first time. The star in a box has a box.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.first_c: Your collider brought a particle round the ring fast enough to hit its target, and something new dropped into the output slot.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.hands_o: A remediator you placed took real pollution out of its region. Owning a cleanup machine is one thing; running it is another.
quest.nerotech.industrial_record.grid_sc: The machines under one of your grid controllers add up to a serious amount of storage. Your network has outgrown a single battery bank.

nerotech.machine.detail.needs_catalyst: Needs a catalyst in its slot
nerotech.machine.detail.output_full: Output full, empty the output slots
nerotech.machine.detail.tank_full: Output tank full: set a face to Output in Side Config and put a Process Tank or a machine that uses it there
nerotech.machine.detail.overheated: Too hot, let it cool or add coolant
nerotech.machine.detail.unpaid: Operation charge refused: check your balance
block.nerotech.plasma_crucible.tooltip: Melts two or three inputs into an alloy. Holds its heat between jobs; a cold start spends energy heating up first
block.nerotech.plate_press.tooltip: Presses ingots into plates or rods, boules into wafers and resin into polymer sheet. The die in its die slot picks the shape
block.nerotech.filament_spooler.tooltip: Draws ingots into wire, and winds wire round a rod or ingot core into coils
nerotech.gui.slot.die: Die: picks the shape, never used up (plate, rod or wafer die)
nerotech.machine.detail.preheating: Heating up to %s heat before it starts
nerotech.machine.detail.tank_other: Output tank holds a different medium: let it drain first
nerotech.machine.detail.needs_die: Needs a die in its die slot
nerotech.machine.detail.wrong_die: This die cannot shape these inputs: try another die
nerotech.machine.detail.nothing_to_colle: Nothing to collect from the air here
nerotech.machine.detail.wrong_stage: No recipe at cascade stage %s of 4: check its place in the line
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.plasma_cruc: Alloy cindrite and iron dust into cindersteel. The crucible keeps its heat between jobs, so keep it busy: a cold crucible spends energy warming up first, and a hot world keeps it warmer.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.plate_press: Fit a die to choose the shape: a plate die for plates and polymer sheet, a rod die for rods, a wafer die for wafers. Dies are never used up.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.filament_sp: Draw copper or cindersteel ingots into wire, then wind four wire round a core (an iron ingot or a cindersteel rod) to make a coil.
block.nerotech.blast_foundry.tooltip: Bulk alloying in batches inside a 3x3x3 or 5x5x5 Foundry Brick shell; a 5x5x5 runs four times the batch. Needs heat through Foundry Heat Ports
block.nerotech.foundry_brick.tooltip: Blast Foundry shell. Glows while its foundry is working
block.nerotech.foundry_heat_port.tooltip: Goes in a Blast Foundry shell. Takes heat from an adjacent Heat Pipe or Heat Exchanger: the only way to heat a foundry
nerotech.machine.detail.foundry_unformed: Not formed, build a 3x3x3 or 5x5x5 Foundry Brick shell
nerotech.machine.detail.foundry_too_cold: Too cold, needs %s furnace heat: feed its Heat Ports with Heat Pipes
nerotech.machine.detail.foundry_short_ba: Not enough for one batch: add more of each input
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.blast_found: The Blast Foundry casts alloys by the batch. Put the controller in the middle of one wall of a hollow 3x3x3 Foundry Brick cube, set Foundry Heat Ports into the shell and feed them heat with Heat Pipes. Power alone will not light it: below a recipe's heat it does nothing. Grow the shell to 5x5x5 for four times the batch.
block.nerotech.centrifuge.tooltip: Spins dusts, slurries and gases into by-products. Side by side and facing the same way, up to four form a cascade that passes gas down the line
block.nerotech.cryo_distiller.tooltip: Distils ices and gases into fractions. Runs faster in cold places and slower in hot ones
block.nerotech.atmospheric_condenser.too: Slowly draws the air around it into gas. What it collects depends on the world; it idles in a vacuum
block.nerotech.reaction_vat.tooltip: Reacts a fluid with a gas or items into acid, resin or coolant (the Chemical Processor washes ore instead). Filled buckets come back empty
nerotech.machine.detail.no_atmosphere: No atmosphere: move it to a world with air
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.entry.centrifuge: Separates dusts, gravel slurry and gases into by-products, some by chance. Line up to four side by side, all facing the same way: each passes its output gas to the one on its right, and each runs the stage for its place in the line. Deuterium becomes helium-3 only at the third centrifuge.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.entry.cryo_disti: Turns ices and canisters into gases and coolant. Cold ambient speeds it up (up to twice as fast); heat slows it down (to half speed).
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.entry.atmospheri: Collects gas from the air, slowly. The overworld gives nitrogen; other worlds give carbon dioxide, sulfur traces or richer nitrogen. In a vacuum it stalls with "No atmosphere".
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.entry.reaction_v: Combines a fluid with a gas or items: sulfur, water and oxygen make sulfuric acid; resin sources and methane make polymer resin; water, nitrogen and blue ice make cryo coolant. Brine buckets work too, and the bucket comes back.
block.nerotech.component_forge.tooltip: Builds servos, capacitors and heat sinks from up to six parts and one fluid. Unlike the Fabricator it takes no patterns and works from its own slots only
block.nerotech.laser_etcher.tooltip: Etches wafers into processors. The focus lens in its lens slot decides what it can etch and is never used up
block.nerotech.crystal_grower.tooltip: Grows crystal boules and focus lenses from a seed, feedstock and water. Keeps growing slowly without power; cold places grow faster
nerotech.gui.slot.lens: Focus lens: held, never used up. The lens sets what can be etched
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.component_f: Up to six parts and one fluid become a component: servos, capacitors, heat sinks. It works from its own slots only, with no patterns and no network.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.laser_etche: Etch a wafer into a processor. Fit a focus lens: it is never used up, and it decides what you can etch. A quartz lens etches Logic Processors, a void lens Quantum Processors.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.crystal_gro: A seed, feedstock and water grow a crystal boule or a focus lens. It keeps growing without power, slowly. Power it for full speed, and build it somewhere cold to grow faster still.
block.nerotech.heat_pipe.tooltip: Carries heat along a run from hotter machines to cooler ones and to Foundry Heat Ports. Long runs lose more on the way. Hot pipes burn to stand on
block.nerotech.heat_exchanger.tooltip: Moves heat between the machine on its front and the Process Tank on its back. Coolant soaks up heat and is used up, lava gives heat and is used up, any other medium stores heat for later. Use it to carry heat to a Foundry; for plain cooling a Coolant Pump with Radiators needs no tank
nerotech.machine.detail.heat_exchanger.n: No Process Tank on the back (or front) face
No machine or heat port opposite the tank
The tank is empty: fill it with coolant, lava or water
nerotech.machine.detail.heat_exchanger.b: Nothing moved: the machine or the tank is already at its limit
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.heat_pipe.t: Run Heat Pipes from a hot machine, such as a reactor or generator, to a Foundry Heat Port. Heat flows from hotter to cooler ends, and every pipe loses a little, so keep runs short. Pipes that glow hurt to stand on.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.heat_exchan: Put a machine on the front and a Process Tank on the back. Cryo coolant or nitrogen cools the machine and is used up; lava heats it and is used up; water or any other medium stores heat, so one exchanger on a reactor and another on a Foundry port share a tank column.
block.nerotech.deep_core_drill.tooltip: Sits on three Drill Derricks and pulls ore from the deposit under its chunk without breaking any ground. Wears out drill heads
block.nerotech.drill_derrick.tooltip: Stack three under a Deep Core Drill
nerotech.gui.slot.drill_head: Drill head: worn down by every operation (iron, cindersteel or glacite)
nerotech.machine.detail.drill.unformed: Needs three Drill Derricks stacked under it
nerotech.machine.detail.drill.dimension_: Deposits are switched off in this dimension
nerotech.machine.detail.drill.depleted: Deposit used up: wait for it to recover or move to another chunk
message.nerotech.survey_scanner.disabled: Deposits are switched off in this dimension
message.nerotech.survey_scanner.no_energ: Not enough charge: a scan needs %s NE. Sneak-use the scanner on a powered block to charge it
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.deep_core_d: Stack three Drill Derricks and put the Deep Core Drill on top. Fit a drill head and power it: every ten seconds it pulls ore from the deposit under its chunk without breaking the ground. Deposits run down and recover slowly. Better heads last longer and yield more.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.survey_scan: Use the scanner to read the deposit under the chunk you stand in: which ore, roughly how much is left, and whether it is recovering. Sneak-use it on a battery or any powered machine to charge it.
block.nerotech.fuel_injector.tooltip: Fusion reactor shell port: feeds deuterium and helium-3 to the fusion reactor only
nerotech.status.fuel_injector.ratio: Needs both deuterium and helium-3 (2 : 1) for a charge
block.nerotech.europium_flux_lattice.too: Fusion shell block: each one in a formed shell cools the burn (the first 8 count)
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.fuel_inject: Build Fuel Injectors into a 7x7x7 fusion shell in place of casings and fill them with deuterium and helium-3 from a gas tank. With both gases at 2 : 1 the reactor burns gas with no cells to craft, at the highest output it has. Next: line the shell with Europium Flux Lattices to keep the hotter burn under control.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.europium_fl: Swap casings in a fusion shell for Europium Flux Lattices. Each one in a formed shell takes 6% off the reactor's heat, up to eight lattices. The beads light when the shell is formed. They are for fusion only.
block.nerotech.induction_charger.tooltip: Charging pad: tops up energy items held or worn by players standing within 4 blocks, and charges companions and other entities in reach. Takes power from any side; stores nothing about who it charged.
nerotech.machine.detail.induction_charge: Player charging is switched off in the config
No energy item can charge from it yet
block.nerotech.annunciator_panel.tooltip: Alarm board: one lamp each for overheat, starved, full, polluting and failing, read from the machines it touches. Needs no power. Crouch-use to pick what a comparator reads.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.induction_c: Power the pad from any side and stand on or near it: energy tools and worn gear charge while you are within 4 blocks. Companions and other entities in reach charge too. It is a charger, not a battery or a power link.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.annunciator: Mount it on a machine: its five lamps show overheat, starved, full, polluting and failing at a glance, and a lamp blinks when its alarm is new. Crouch-use to choose what a comparator reads: any alarm (3 per lit alarm) or one alarm at full strength.
gui.nerotech.fuel_injector.ratio.tooltip: One charge takes two parts deuterium to one part helium-3
gui.nerotech.fuel_injector.status.ready: Ready: holds a charge for the reactor
gui.nerotech.induction_charger.pad.toolt: Charges energy items you hold or wear while you stand in reach
gui.nerotech.annunciator_panel.alarm.sta: A touching machine is out of input or energy
gui.nerotech.annunciator_panel.alarm.ful: A touching machine cannot place its output
gui.nerotech.annunciator_panel.alarm.pol: A touching machine is emitting pollution
gui.nerotech.annunciator_panel.alarm.fai: A touching machine is breaking down
gui.nerotech.annunciator_panel.channel.t: Crouch-use the panel with an empty hand to change
gui.nerotech.annunciator_panel.none: No machine touching: mount it on a machine
message.nerotech.tool.no_energy: Not enough charge (needs %s NE). Charge it at an Induction Charger
message.nerotech.cutting_lance.lens.glac: Glacite (cold: ice and glass come away whole)
message.nerotech.cutting_lance.not_a_len: Hold a focus lens in your other hand to fit it
message.nerotech.arc_wrench.picked_up: Picked up %s with its contents. Use on a block face to put it down
message.nerotech.arc_wrench.cannot_place: Cannot put the machine down here
message.nerotech.arc_wrench.refused.not_: The Arc Wrench only moves NeroTech machines
message.nerotech.arc_wrench.refused.carr: Break this one with a pickaxe: it keeps its contents on its own item
message.nerotech.arc_wrench.refused.form: Part of a multiblock: take the structure apart first
message.nerotech.arc_wrench.refused.alre: The wrench is already carrying a machine
message.nerotech.arc_wrench.refused.not_: You may not change blocks here
message.nerotech.multimeter.nothing: Nothing to measure on this block
message.nerotech.filter_mask.already_fit: A cartridge is already fitted (%s exposures left)
message.nerotech.filter_mask.fouled: Your Filter Mask cartridge fouled into a Dirty Filter
